world: Matte: Apple Wallet crossed with Instagram (user-pinned), with no gradients, gloss or translucency

radii.rule: --r-pill only on genuinely circular things: rings, dots, the colour chip

elevation.rule: offset plus soft blur, tinted by the ink, paired with --edge (a 1px inset hairline); shadow only, no lit edge

type.mono: none: digits, dates, counts and the clock are the sans with tabular numerals
bans: kicker or eyebrow above a heading

motion.durations: 140-320ms; the theme crossfade is a 280ms view transition
motion.signature: blocks inside main fade and rise in, staggered, once on arrival
motion.reducedMotion: app.css collapses animation and transition durations to 1ms and index.css drops the theme crossfade; landing.css disables animation and transition outright

components.pass: .pass — the week, on the theme's pass field, count against target, day strip opening the month calendar
components.goalCard: .goal-card — matte card, title, category, usual place, 7-dot week
components.ring: .app-ring — conic progress; dashed outline when empty; count repeated as text
components.shell: .app — 76px labelled rail on desktop, bottom tab bar under 860px holding at most five tabs with a More sheet, solid top bar
components.dialog: .app-dialog — centred card, bottom sheet under 860px, focus trap and scroll lock
components.calendar: .cal — six Monday-led weeks, accent fill for logged days, dashed for past empty days
components.themeGrid: ThemeGrid — one shared picker in the top bar, Settings and the landing page; Light, Dark, then Your themes
components.timer: .timer — two fixed semantic colours outside the tokens: --go #2f9e55 and --pause #d9861a
components.emptyStates: .onboard / .app-status — one centred block at a 40rem measure

accessibility.contrast: 338 checks across 26 themes, all passing at 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for fills; custom themes are derived to the same minimums
accessibility.targets: 44px on coarse pointers; 36px minimum with spacing on fine pointers
accessibility.focus: never suppressed; inverts to --color-on-accent inside the pass
accessibility.headings: one h1 per page (top bar title); regions labelled by h2
accessibility.colorAlone: never carries meaning — progress states also read as text
